SageTVPlugin.Name: PWA MiniClient
SageTVPlugin.Description:
A Progressive Web App (PWA) MiniClient for SageTV.
Access your SageTV server from any device with a modern web browser — phones, tablets, laptops, or smart TVs. No app install required; simply open the URL.
The plugin installs an embedded Jetty web server that bridges browser WebSocket connections to the SageTV MiniClient TCP protocol, serving the PWA interface and relaying graphics commands, input events, and media streams in real time.
Features: - Full SageTV UI rendered in-browser via HTML5 Canvas - Media playback with transcoding support (requires ffmpeg) - PWA install-to-home-screen for native app experience - Optional HTTP Basic Auth (username/password) for securing access - Startup requirement checks (Jetty, API, port, web root) - Configurable bridge port and web root path - Navigation drawer with volume controls - Touch and keyboard input support
After install, open http://{SageTV-IP}:8099 in your browser to connect.
SageTVPlugin.Author: galeforcesage
SageTVPlugin.ReleaseNotes:
Version 1.0.0.3 - Rolls up ~95 commits merged since the July 7 (1.0.0.2) build so fresh installs get the current client + bridge - Bridge: live-follow /rawmedia for in-progress recordings (live DIRECT_PLAY no longer ends early) - Media: NG Playback Context consumer wiring; live-edge seek clamp (MSE + AVPlay) - Media: passive on-device burn-test capability learning (video/audio/container) - Tizen: AVPlay native playback, prepare watchdog + /transcode fallback, DIRECT_PLAY routed to native /rawmedia - Audio Equalizer / AudioProcessing v1 (browser + Tizen remote nav) - WebGL renderer + retained-mode frame cache (large blit speedups) - Nav drawer polish (Back arrow flipped: arrow on top) - Numerous NG surface-declaration, reconnect, and playback-stability fixes
Version 1.0.0.2 - Menu performance: instrumentation (?perf=1), image-cache accounting-leak fix (bounded surface budget), and platform-aware canvas smoothing (low on iPad/Tizen) - Bridge: TCP->WebSocket frame coalescing to cut browser main-thread load during GFX bursts (tunable via WS_COALESCE_MAX_BYTES) - Java 8 compatibility: builds and runs on stock Java 8 SageTV V9 servers (JVM MinVersion lowered to 1.8; compile enforced with --release 8) - HTTP Basic Auth support (configurable username/password in plugin settings) - Startup requirement checks (Jetty classpath, SageTV API, port, web root) - Auto-skip Configuration Wizard for PWA clients (MCFullyConfigured)
Version 1.0.0.1 - Fix bandwidth display: track actual media stream rate instead of WebSocket protocol data - Status bar now shows sustained transcoding bitrate matching Placeshifter behavior - GPU hardware acceleration support (nvenc/qsv/vaapi/videotoolbox/auto) - Placeshifter-style blue status bar with 15-bar buffer gauge
